title: Cranberry growers flood their fields at harvest time. Why?

posts.facebook:
Cranberry growers flood their fields at harvest time. Why?

The answer is further down ↓

·
·
·

Answer: Ripe cranberries float, so they can be gathered off the top of the water. The berries have tiny air pockets inside, and they grow on dry beds the rest of the year.

It's one of the 300 questions in our Christmas Quiz Book, in a UK and an American edition, on Amazon.
